rule.A: both fixed S1 and S2, at both H5 and H10, have positive mean and median RankIC and positive raw signed spread, at least 3/4 positive blocks, and all 30 leave-one-out mean RankICs positive; recommend only future independent preregistration
rule.B: A is not met but at least one fixed single-factor signal has positive mean RankIC at both horizons; seek more independent evidence rather than promote a model
rule.C: neither fixed single-factor signal has positive mean RankIC at both horizons; the present short-horizon reversal hypothesis is not supported
rule.D: actual access or quality prevents a valid historical numerical run
rule.label: EXPLORATORY_RECOMMENDATION_HEURISTIC_NOT_VALIDATION
rule.ridge: paired complexity comparison is reported; learned sign reversals never silently redefine the reversal hypothesis or create a formal candidate
